description: Fetches the latest version of an MDMA documentation file from the public GitHub repo (raw.githubusercontent.com/MobileReality/mdma) and returns its contents as text. Allowed paths: any entry from list-docs, plus any *.md file under "docs/" or "blueprints/". Defaults to the "main" branch.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the doc, e.g. "docs/getting-started/quick-start.md" or "blueprints/kyc-case/README.md"

ref.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA). Defaults to "main".

name: get-doc
